scope: Recorded routing-only native subscription changes reach the owned Rust SDK through signed metadata hints and fresh journal reads. Local macOS arm64 functional scope; no full SDK, whole default suite or profile acceptance.
implementation: ReconciliationHint is bounded original operation/record/selector identity plus counters, with no result, binding set, readiness or media grant. Store lookup requires durable completed routing-only stream.reconcile, confirmed effect, exact original scope/credential/key/Device/generation and current selector/native source permission.

Only after durable completion, the server coalesces latest metadata per original physical writer/Connection (64 queued Connections, one flight, bounded retry age). Credential refresh installs a current listener and retires the old source. Queues and unfinished metadata jobs retain no idle permission reader.

The recorded upstream patch seals journal output to the original confirmed native writer and current authenticated physical incarnation. Current host permission is reacquired at actual reliable IO. Control capacity stays reserved; an unfinished sink is destroyed before its current reader releases.

The SDK treats the signed hint only as a trigger. Known originally issued selector, exact owned scope, bounded pending hint, original host/parent/counter identity and current operation.get completion are required before revision observation. One existing bounded worker multiplexes media, control, callbacks and observation-only jobs. No native parameter answer is sent for routing-only changes.

Stale/foreign/unissued/malformed hints and mismatched current results cannot acquire custody. A pending hint cannot replace an unsettled preparation original recovery identity. Captured matching bindings advance the local counter without new native resources. A null routing-only capture may advance only its exact installed predecessor and no pending preparation, since the journal proves no physical change; it invents no bindings and bindings_adopted stays false. Resource-replacement null captures remain unresolved.

behaviors: Fresh current journal and correlated ACK precede route-only observation/counter advancement; old original results never rewind it.
Changed announced host record/counter refuses, unmatched binding captures never install, and stale/foreign/unissued/nonrouting hints do not disturb other control.
A routing hint cannot overwrite an unsettled original resource preparation; null route-only capture advances only the exact installed predecessor without fabricating bindings.

Same-revision routing-only completion is observed with matching or unavailable capture without inventing bindings or changing native ports; older-predecessor and repeated current identities are ignored.
